function.name: calculate_derivative
function.description: Calculate the derivative of a single-variable function. Unlike calculate_integral, which calculates the definite integral, this calculates the derivative.

x_value.description: The x-value at which the derivative should be calculated.

order.description: The order of the derivative (optional). Default is 1st order.

function.name: calculate_integral
function.description: Calculate the definite integral of a single-variable function. Unlike calculate_derivative, which calculates the derivative, this calculates the definite integral.

a.description: The lower bound of the integration.

b.description: The upper bound of the integration.
